svg.aria-label: Chair Computer Vision — Trained and benchmarked three YOLO architectures (YOLOv8n/m, YOLO11s) to detect chairs and their components for automated furniture assembly checks. Diagnosed weaknesses via confusion matrices and PR/F1 curves, then iterated on the dataset.
